name: mammadoveshgin
description: Clean-code skills for coding agents, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Write without AI slop or security holes, finish a change before committing (interrogate, deslop, test audit, audit, gates, fresh-context review), rewrite a path or the whole repo slice by slice, hunt bugs red-test-first, prove tests with mutation probes, install lint gates and hooks. Every skill ends with a short analytics report.
